_review: reviewed source text (English). Scheme titles and document names come from the mock portal seed (rules/*.json), not from here.
greeting: Hello! Let me check which welfare schemes you qualify for.
ask_annual_income: What is your family's total income in one year?
match_one: {title}: you qualify, based on your {facts}. It needs {n} documents. Shall I start the application?
match_many: You qualify for {n} schemes, based on your {facts}. The top ones are {top}. Which one shall I apply for?
match_more_one: You can also apply for {title}. Shall I start that application?
match_more_many: You can apply for {n} more schemes, such as {top}. Which one shall I apply for?
all_applied: You have already applied for every scheme you qualify for.
choose_reask: Please tell me the scheme's name, for example {title}.
not_eligible_topic: You don't qualify for the {topic} schemes right now, because {reasons}. Shall I check other schemes?
not_eligible_all: You don't qualify for any scheme right now, because {reasons}.
not_eligible_one: {title}: you don't qualify right now, because {reasons}.
ask_start: Shall I start the application for {title}?
proceed_declined: Okay. Tell me when you want to apply.
confirm_ask: Shall I submit your application for {title}? Say yes to submit.
readback_unsure: I wasn't fully sure I heard this right: {fields}.
docs_missing_ask: {n} documents for {title} are still missing: say yes to submit anyway, or upload them first.
docs_missing_ask_1: 1 document for {title} is still missing: say yes to submit anyway, or upload it first.
confirm_reask: Please say yes to submit, or no to stop.
submitted_next: You also qualify for {title}; to apply, say its name.
already_submitted: Already submitted. Your application ID is {app_id}.
status_none: You have not applied for anything yet.
llm_unavailable: Sorry, I can't answer that right now.
field_mobile: Mobile number registered on the portal
ask_form_name: What is your full name, as on your ID card?
ask_form_date: What is your date of birth? For example: 5 March 1962.
ask_form_mobile: Which mobile number is registered on the portal? The login code goes there.
ask_form_account: What is your bank account number? Please say the digits slowly.
ask_form_ifsc: What is your bank's IFSC code? It is in the passbook, like S B I N 0 0 0 1 2 3 4.
ask_form_declaration: One last thing. The form says: "{text}" Is that true for you? Say yes or no.
form_intro: To apply for {title} on the portal, I need a few details.
portal_slow: The portal is waking up, so the first step may take a minute.
docs_needed_portal: Before I fill the {title} form, please upload: {docs}. Then say continue.
docs_bad_format: Please upload these again as PDF, JPG or PNG under 5 MB: {docs}.
portal_not_configured: The application portal is not set up yet, so I can't apply now. Nothing was submitted.
portal_unavailable: The portal is not reachable right now. Nothing was submitted; please try again in a few minutes.
declaration_declined: Without this declaration the portal won't accept the application, so I have stopped. Nothing was submitted.
dob_mismatch: That date makes you {age}, but you told me {said}. Please say your date of birth again.
mobile_refused: The portal did not accept that number; it must be the mobile registered on the portal.
otp_sent: I've opened the portal and sent a code to your mobile ending {last4}. Please tell me the 6-digit code.
session_restart: The portal session ended, so I'm logging in again.
otp_failed: The code didn't work three times, so I have stopped. Nothing was submitted. Say {title} to try again.
otp_expired: That code has expired. Say 'send again' and I'll get a new one.
otp_wrong: That code didn't work. Please say it again, or say 'send again' for a new one. {left} tries left.
otp_resent: I've sent a new code. Please tell me the 6 digits.
otp_unclear: Please tell me the 6-digit code from the SMS, or say 'send again'.
already_on_portal: This scheme was already submitted on the portal. Your application ID is {app_id}.
portal_readback: Please check: {name}, born {dob}, income {income}, payment to the account ending {last4}.
portal_declare: By saying yes you also affirm: "{declaration}", and allow read-only access for {hours} hours to track the status.
safe_stop: The portal looked different from what I expected at the {step} step, so I stopped. Nothing was submitted. Say 'try again' to restart, or continue on the portal yourself.
safe_stop_ended: Okay, I've stopped. Nothing was submitted.
